rejectionAudit.rootCause: Task-specific PREPARE_MEDICAL appends an explicitly medicine>=1 candidate without the generic public-resource guard; the model selects it despite public medicine=0. The authority rejects correctly.
exclusions: Not a post-inference resource race: medicine is already zero in all 10 exact model inputs
rejectionAudit.modelContribution: The model violates its own visible precondition on all 10 attempts; medical has no positive weak-label examples in the 96-case corpus. Distribution shift is a supported limitation, not a proven causal ablation.
rejectionAudit.scope: V1 audit only; no frozen V2 code/data modified.

limitations: One paired seed, original full-map mode disabled; equal perfect/8 survival is a tie, not an improvement.
Forty council rows per arm are reference policy; only 320 rows in the JEV arm are real neural action decisions.
Applied counts include communication/no-op-like repeated moves, and do not by themselves prove promise completion.
V1 taskCompleted trajectory field underreports domain-only task completion; compare final task state and committed task_completed events.
The same v1 policy/data errors are preserved; this audit does not rerun or relabel this episode.
